oe_v49_mp_grant_regional_company_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_participant value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_v49_mp_is_cossack_sphere = yes
			current_year >= 1480
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_cossack_sich_host years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_v49_mp_is_black_army_sphere = yes
			current_year >= 1440
			current_year <= 1650
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_hungarian_black_army years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_v49_mp_is_swiss_sphere = yes
			current_year >= 1380
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_swiss_royal_guard years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_v49_mp_is_varangian_sphere = yes
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_varangian_free_company years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_v49_mp_is_barbary_sphere = yes
			num_of_ports >= 1
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_barbary_corsair_flotilla years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_v49_mp_is_caribbean_sphere = yes
			num_of_ports >= 1
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_caribbean_privateer_armada years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			current_year < 1400
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_varangian_free_company years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_swiss_royal_guard years = 12 mode = replace }
	}
}

oe_v49_gp_record_master_patron_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_participant value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_masters_hosted } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_masters_hosted value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_masters_hosted add = 1 }
	add_prestige = 6
	if = {
		limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_great_persons }
		situation:oe_sit_v49_great_persons = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 35 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index add = 4 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 100 } }
		}
	}
}
